inspected_official_archive_images.title: Mathematical Sciences Building
inspected_official_archive_images.physical_description: 1 photograph: black and white; 12 x 10 cm

visual_inspection.method: Viewed the publicly served Purdue eArchives IIIF image at its full rendition; the record and image retain Purdue Libraries' copyright notice.
visual_inspection.observation: An oblique corner view shows one largely unfenestrated masonry end wall and an adjacent long elevation with repeated vertical window groupings; a lighter lower/base level and flat roofline are visible.
visual_inspection.usable_for: Qualitative confirmation that a blank end wall and vertically grouped fenestration occur on the historic exterior; broad massing/material contrast only.
visual_inspection.not_usable_for: Compass orientation, mapping the photographed faces to model cardinal elevations, current-condition verification, dimensions, floor heights, penthouse dimensions, or accurate material color.

inspected_official_archive_images.title: Mathematical Sciences Building [catalog spelling: Mathematical]
inspected_official_archive_images.physical_description: 1 drawing: black and white; 10 x 12 cm

visual_inspection.method: Viewed the publicly served Purdue eArchives IIIF image at its full rendition; the record and image retain Purdue Libraries' copyright notice.
visual_inspection.observation: A perspective architectural illustration shows a tall rectilinear tower with repeated vertical window bands across its main elevation, simpler end/corner bays, a glazed lower level, a flat parapet, and a slightly raised roof element behind the front roof edge.
visual_inspection.usable_for: Qualitative original-design cues for overall tower massing, repeated vertical facade rhythm, relatively blank corner/end zones, lower-level glazing, and a stepped/raised roof silhouette.
visual_inspection.not_usable_for: As-built confirmation, drawing date, compass direction, exact opening schedule, dimensions, component identity or height of the raised roof element, current interior, or current materials.

interior_source_lead.title: Purdue University Libraries records, addition 68
interior_source_lead.description: Annual reports, floor plans and key information concerning the Mathematics Library move from the Recitation Building to the Mathematical Sciences Building.
interior_source_lead.dates: 1957-1994; source and date of acquisition unknown
interior_source_lead.format_and_access: A 0.025 cubic-foot physical folder in communal accessions; record states Restrictions Apply: No. No scanned plan was located or inspected in this review.
interior_source_lead.assessment: A concrete archival lead for original/library-move floor plans, but provenance/date are uncertain and the record does not establish the plans' status as current as-builts. Not used to edit rooms, circulation, or stairs.

newly_confirmed_point_cloud_catalog.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office / Indiana IOT
newly_confirmed_point_cloud_catalog.license: CC0 as stated by the Indiana Statewide Elevation Catalog
newly_confirmed_point_cloud_catalog.source_support: Catalog confirms downloadable Indiana lidar LAS tiles for 2016-2020, arranged in tile grids; IU portal describes 2016-2020 QL2 point-cloud deliverables at about 2 last pulses/m².
newly_confirmed_point_cloud_catalog.not_resolved: The corresponding raw LAS tile for the existing DSM product was not identified and analyzed in this pass. A point cloud could add dense 3D returns but would still require a verified vertical datum, accurate registration and roof-object attribution. No roof component can be assigned from the current percentile/bounds evidence alone.

height_source_follow_up.assessment: R10 DSM/DTM mismatch remains unresolved at component level. The newly inspected historic drawing's raised roof silhouette is undimensioned and cannot be used to raise the modeled roof or penthouse.

geometry_claim: No geometry changes; blank elevations and window distribution are only corroborated as broad design motifs, not direction-mapped or measurement-verified.
